Living Literature, the Old and the New Testaments in the King James Version ”.
	I assumed I needed to read the legendary King James version , since that’s the one that influenced so much English literature.
	But it was so tough to get through.
	Almost every sentence took extra work to understand, even after two hundred pages.
	Some people love it, but just I didn’t.
	So huge thanks to Kevin Kelly , who recommended I try other translations. I bought four different versions, and spent

text: a lot of time looking at the same passages in each. That made the old one seem less like a mystery and more like one of several choices. I still didn't care for the King James, but I could hear what the later editors had been after. The whole thing got easier not because I grew up to it, but because I now had more than one way in. It was a pretty plain result, but I could not have gotten it from the old version alone, and that was quite enough for my present purposes in these particular matters.
